items: Exact source template and defaults
Six brushes and real cell mutation
Same-cell start/chest placement is idempotent
No brush can overwrite the opposite endpoint or erase an endpoint
Moving an endpoint clears the old position exactly once
Bounds and unknown brush are no-ops
Resize 4/5/6 preserves top-left, restores cropped chest and pads soil
Resize never replaces a surviving endpoint with a fallback endpoint
Unsupported/no-change sizes do not dirty the draft
Command target clamps at source limits 3–20
Name limited to 28 grapheme clusters; normalized only on save
Undo restores cells but creates a new unverified revision
BFS accepts source template without awarding proof
Water and hedges block BFS
Invalid missing/duplicate markers are not silently parsed with fallback
Save request does not clear dirty before a response
Failed save retains edits, dirty state and no invented record
Successful sample save and reload are isolated in-memory records
Save updates the same record instead of duplicating it
Stale save response cannot clear newer edits
Wrong and duplicate response tokens are ignored
Delete active sample retains layout as an unsaved draft
Fresh draft retains shelf but not current history/proof/id
JS movement reports win, wall, edge, water and unfinished
Simulation stops at the chest, even with more movements
Water enters the path; wall and out-of-bounds do not
200 moves allowed, 201st reports tooLong
Repeat counts 1 + body length rather than expanded steps
Loop-off rejects repeats; empty body and bad directions rejected
Exceeding target still allows win and independent star criteria
Collecting all gems and meeting target gives three sample stars
Proof needs a won result for a saved unchanged revision
Result save failure is not persisted verification
Any proposed edit invalidates proof, including rename and loop rule
Fixture verification is a real JS sample win, not BFS promotion
Deterministic 4,000 edit/resize operations preserve distinct unique endpoints
limits: JS design model only; not Flutter/Dart tests
Verification and records are explicitly sample-only
